passages.label: Recorded statement — direction of travel
passages.text: I had come off Gilbert Road and I was heading eastbound along Harrison Street. I was going about 25 miles per hour, no faster than that, because it is a narrow stretch.

passages.label: Recorded statement — the second vehicle
passages.text: The other car reversed out of a parking space straight into my lane. I had no time to do anything about it. It came backwards out of the line of parked cars and I hit it with my front end.

passages.label: Recorded statement — conditions
passages.text: I could not tell you whether the street lights had come on by then. I do not remember that detail.
